mapper.insert: insert into sawon(sabun, saname, deptno, pwd, sapay, sajob, sahire, saemail, satel, saaddr, sazipcode) values( #{sabun}, #{saname}, #{deptno}, #{pwd}, #{sapay}, #{sajob}, #{sahire}, #{saemail}, #{satel}, #{saaddr}, #{sazipcode} )
mapper.update: update sawon set saname = #{saname}, deptno = #{deptno}, pwd = #{pwd}, sapay = #{sapay}, sajob = #{sajob}, sahire = #{sahire}, saemail = #{saemail}, satel = #{satel}, saaddr = #{saaddr}, sazipcode = #{sazipcode} where sabun = #{sabun}
mapper.select: select count(sabun)cnt from sawon where sastatus = '재직'
SELECT s.saname, s.deptno, d.dname FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno ORDER BY s.sahire DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.sajob FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN job_position p on s.sajob = p.sajob ORDER BY s.sahire DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.sabun, s.saname, s.deptno, d.dname FROM sawon s JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE s.sastatus = '재직' ORDER BY d.deptno, s.saname
select s.*, d.dname from sawon s join dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno where s.sabun = #{sabun}
select sajob from sawon where sabun=#{sabun}
select sl.sabun, s.saname, d.deptno, d.dname from dept d left join sawonleader sl on d.deptno = sl.deptno left join sawon s on sl.sabun = s.sabun order by d.deptno asc
mapper.update: update sawonleader set sabun = null where deptno = #{deptno}
update sawonleader set sabun = #{sabun} where deptno = #{deptno}
mapper.select: select case when sl.sabun in null the 'user' when sl.deptno = 10 then 'admin' else 'manager' end as current_role from sawon s join sawonleader sl on s.sabun - sl.sabun where s.sabun = #{sabun}
select sabun, saname from sawon where deptno = #{deptno} and sastatus = '재직'
